# Orchid Documentation
Orchid is a generic, platform-agnostic multi-agent AI framework built on LangGraph (Python) and Next.js.
Audience: developers building or deploying multi-agent AI systems.
Each entry below is a documentation page with its URL and description.
Last generated: 2026-11-20

## Overview

Ecosystem Overview — Five packages, one coherent framework: library, API, CLI, MCP gateway, and frontend.
https://orchestratorindex.com/ecosystem (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/ecosystem.md)

Quickstart — Run Orchid locally in under ten minutes with the basketball demo.
https://orchestratorindex.com/quickstart (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/quickstart.md)

## Concepts

Agents — How OrchidAgent works: YAML configuration, skills, MCP tools, and the run lifecycle.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/agents (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/agents.md)

Supervisor — The LangGraph supervisor: routing, history limits, and sliding-window summarisation.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/supervisor (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/supervisor.md)

Hierarchical RAG — OrchidRAGScope, the 5-level hierarchy, retrieval strategies, ingestion pipelines, and the parse-once pattern.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/rag (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/rag.md)

MCP Integration — Connecting MCP servers to Orchid agents: none, passthrough, and OAuth auth modes.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/mcp (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/mcp.md)

OAuth & Dynamic Client Registration — How auth.mode: oauth triggers RFC 9728 → 8414 → 7591 discovery and manages per-user tokens.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/oauth (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/oauth.md)

Embeddings — Supported embedding models, dimension differences, and re-indexing requirements.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/embeddings (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/embeddings.md)

Multi-LLM Support — Provider agnosticism via LiteLLM: configure any model per agent, swap at runtime.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/multi-llm (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/multi-llm.md)

Chat Persistence — OrchidChatStorage ABC, the built-in in-memory default, and durable SQLite/PostgreSQL backends via plugins.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/persistence (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/persistence.md)

Tool Call Strategies — The all, sequential, and llm_decides strategies and how to register custom ones.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/tool-strategies (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/tool-strategies.md)

Document Parsing — PDF and image parsing with the parse-once pattern and the pluggable parser registry.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/document-parsing (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/document-parsing.md)

Mini-Agents — Per-agent opt-in fan-out: decompose a multi-part request into parallel sub-agents, each running its own focused agentic loop.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/mini-agents (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/mini-agents.md)

Pollen + Bloom — Event-driven AI jobs: Pollen ingests and persists signals; Bloom matches them to triggers and runs them through the supervisor.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/pollen-bloom (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/pollen-bloom.md)

Chat Summarization — Running summaries, structured entity extraction, RAG-augmented conversation memory, and configurable truncation strategies.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/chat-summarization (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/chat-summarization.md)

Decision Models — A dedicated LLM layer that returns typed, calibrated judgements for internal routing, gating and selection seams — with deterministic fallbacks.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/decision-models (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/decision-models.md)

Data Pipelines — Typed, run-scoped DAGs that combine deterministic code, LLM jobs, agents, decisions, maps and sub-pipelines over a validated information graph.
https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/pipelines (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/concepts/pipelines.md)

## Packages

orchid — The core Python library: ABCs, agents, graph builder, RAG, and persistence.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid.md)

orchid-api — FastAPI server exposing the Orchid framework over HTTP with SSE streaming.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-api (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-api.md)

orchid-cli — Command-line interface for interacting with Orchid without running the API.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-cli (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-cli.md)

orchid-mcp — Node.js MCP gateway that exposes Orchid to any MCP-capable host LLM.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-mcp (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-mcp.md)

orchid-frontend — Next.js 16 multi-chat UI with SSE streaming and file upload support.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-frontend (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-frontend.md)

orchid-storage-sqlite — SQLite storage plugin: chat persistence, MCP stores, event storage, migrations, and the sqlite checkpointer.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-storage-sqlite (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-storage-sqlite.md)

orchid-storage-postgres — PostgreSQL storage plugin: chat and config persistence, MCP stores, events, checkpointer, and visibility fragment.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-storage-postgres (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-storage-postgres.md)

orchid-rag-qdrant — Qdrant vector and doc-store plugin for the Orchid AI framework.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-rag-qdrant (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-rag-qdrant.md)

orchid-rag-chroma — ChromaDB vector-backend plugin for on-disk, zero-infrastructure RAG.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-rag-chroma (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-rag-chroma.md)

orchid-rag-neo4j — Neo4j graph-store plugin for knowledge-graph RAG.
https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-rag-neo4j (markdown: https://orchestratorindex.com/packages/orchid-rag-neo4j.md)
